item.title: Common Mistakes Businesses Make When Launching a New Website
item.description:
Introduction

Launching a new website is a significant moment for any business. An effective and functional website can elevate your brand, attract more customers, and boost revenue. Yet, many businesses fail during this process by making avoidable mistakes that hinder their success.

1. Ignoring the Importance of Planning

One of the biggest mistakes businesses make is rushing into development without a well-defined plan. A website must have clear objectives and a defined target audience to be effective.
